Prepare datasets¶

In [34]:
# Merged extracted datasets
observations_w_climate = pd.read_csv("./Exports/observations_Climate.csv")
observations_w_DEM = pd.read_csv("./Exports/observations_DEM_data.csv")
# Slice climate data to only include 2015-2024
obs_w_clim = observations_w_climate[observations_w_climate["date"] >= "2015-01-01"].copy()
obs_w_clim = obs_w_clim[obs_w_clim["date"] < "2025-01-01"].copy()
obs_w_clim = obs_w_clim.reset_index()
obs_w_clim = obs_w_clim.drop(columns="index")
obs_w_clim["id"] = obs_w_clim.index + 1
# Slice DEM data to only include 2014-2024
obs_w_dem = observations_w_DEM[observations_w_DEM["date"] >= "2015-01-01"].copy()
obs_w_dem = obs_w_dem[obs_w_dem["date"] < "2025-01-01"].copy()
obs_w_dem = obs_w_dem.reset_index()
obs_w_dem = obs_w_dem.drop(columns="index")
obs_w_dem["id"] = obs_w_dem.index + 1

       'NOAA_mintm', 'Potential_', 'Land_surfa', 'LS_NDVI', 'Degree_of_',
       'land_use_m', 'SRTM_Aspec', 'SRTM_Eleva', 'SRTM_Slope', 'Dist_t_roa',

Run RF with default parameters¶

In [107]:
clf = ensemble.RandomForestClassifier() # Create model using the *default model parameters*
clf.fit(X_train, y_train) # Train the model using the calibration dataset

print("***Calibration Data (n = %d)***" % len(X_train))
y_pred = clf.predict(X_train) # Predict Y values based on Observed X values
score = clf.score(X_train, y_train) * 100 # Calculate accuracy score (%)
print("Accuracy = %0.3f%%" % score)
cm = metrics.confusion_matrix(y_train, y_pred) # Create confusion matrix
print("Confusion Matrix")
print(cm)

print("***Validation Data (n = %d)***" % len(X_test))
y_pred = clf.predict(X_test) # Predict Y values based on Observed X values
score = clf.score(X_test, y_test) * 100 # Calculate accuracy score (%)
print("Accuracy = %0.3f%%" % score)
cm = metrics.confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred) # Create confusion matrix
print("Confusion Matrix")
print(cm)

Test different hyperparameters¶

In [108]:
params = {
    'n_estimators': [100],  # Just use 100
    'max_depth': [10, 20, None],  # More reasonable depths
    'class_weight': ['balanced', None],  # Address imbalance
    'min_samples_split': [2, 10]
}
# 1 × 3 × 2 × 2 = 12 combinations × 3 folds = 36 fits
In [109]:
# Setup Grid Search Cross-validation
clf = ensemble.RandomForestClassifier() # Create Random Forest Classification object
folds = 3 # Number of folds for cross-validation
cv = GridSearchCV(clf, params, cv = folds)
In [114]:
# Run Grid Search Cross-validation to find the best model parameter values!
cv.fit(X, y) # Performs the Grid Search Cross-validation - This will take time to run!
print("Best Parameters")
print(cv.best_params_)
print("Best Accuracy Score = %0.3f%%" % (cv.best_score_ * 100))

Running the RF with revised parameters¶

In [120]:
# Just retrain with better parameters based on what we know
clf = ensemble.RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    max_depth=20,
    min_samples_split=10,
    class_weight='balanced',
    random_state=42,
    oob_score=True
)
# Takes 5-10 minutes, likely improves your results significantly
In [154]:
# Built-in Random Forest Model Evaluation Metrics
print("***Internal Model Evaluation***")
print("Out-of-bag (OOB) Accuracy = %0.3f%%" % (clf.oob_score_*100))
print("Feature Importances - See Plot Below")
f, ax = plt.subplots()
pd.DataFrame(clf.feature_importances_).plot.bar(ax=ax)
ax.set_ylabel('Relative Importance')
ax.set_xlabel('Explanatory Variable')
legend = ax.legend()
legend.remove()
plt.savefig('explanatory_variable_importance.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')

import geopandas as gpd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap

# Get test data indices to link back to coordinates
test_indices = X_test.index

# Get fire probabilities for test data
fire_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create a dataframe with test data coordinates and predictions
test_results = full_data.loc[test_indices].copy()
test_results['fire_probability'] = fire_probs
test_results['predicted_class'] = clf.predict(X_test)

# If it's not already a GeoDataFrame, convert it
if not isinstance(test_results, gpd.GeoDataFrame):
    test_results = gpd.GeoDataFrame(test_results, geometry='geometry', crs='EPSG:4326')

# Plot points colored by fire probability

                            cmap=cmap,

                            ax=ax,
                            legend=True,
                            vmin=0, vmax=1,

                                        'orientation': 'vertical',
                                        'shrink': 0.8})
